_nota: Eventos del '?' (dll/core/src/events.rs). Imagen = extract/ui/carga/<imagen>.png (pantallas de carga del juego). Textos cortos estilo carta, sin guion largo. Efectos: runas, bendición, maldicion, objeto, templar, combate.

eventos.texto: Someone left the fire burning. Beside it, a tied bundle and a bowl of runes.

opciones.resultado: The warmth stays inside you.
Nobody comes back for it.

azar.resultado: There is something useful inside.
A shadow rises on the other side of the fire.

opciones.resultado: The fire is still burning when you look back.

eventos.texto: The table is set. There is a free chair and a tired-eyed man watching you.

opciones.resultado: He talks of enemies you have yet to meet. You keep what is useful.
He pays without haggling. That worries you.
The chair will still be there.

eventos.texto: A huge pot, half buried, asks for help in a warrior's voice.

opciones.detalle: Gain 150 runes. Gain an uncommon blessing.
opciones.resultado: It pops free with a crash and gives you something from inside. It says you will meet again.
There were more runes inside than you expected. And something else.
Its shouts follow you for a good while.

eventos.texto: A black rider patrols the road. He hasn't seen you yet.

opciones.resultado: He reins in the horse and lowers his flail.

opciones.detalle: 50%: he rides past. 50%: he finds you.

azar.resultado: The hooves fade away.
The horse stops right in front of you.

opciones.resultado: He stops to pick them up. You don't.

eventos.texto: A queen cradles an amber egg. She offers rebirth to whoever pays.

opciones.detalle: Lose 300 runes. Gain a rare blessing.
opciones.resultado: Something in you changes shape. For the better.

opciones.detalle: Gain a rare item. Curse: Under the Moon.
opciones.resultado: She gives it to you. The moon does not forget.
She doesn't look up from the egg.

eventos.texto: A stone tower strides on legs. A bell hangs at the top.

azar.resultado: The sound fills your chest.
The echo won't go away.

opciones.resultado: You come down with full hands and shaking arms.
It goes its way. You go yours.

eventos.texto: An altar with candles and offerings. Some pilgrims pray on their knees.

opciones.resultado: Nobody asks who you pray to.
Nobody opens their eyes. That is worse.

opciones.detalle: Lose 100 runes. Gain a common blessing.
opciones.resultado: One of the candles lights itself.
They don't look up.

eventos.texto: His sword is taller than you. He points it at you and waits.

opciones.detalle: Elite fight. A rare item if you win.
opciones.resultado: He nods. The rain gets heavier.

opciones.detalle: Lose 150 runes. Gain an uncommon item.
opciones.resultado: He drinks in silence. As he leaves, he leaves you something.
He looks at you for a long while and walks away.

eventos.texto: He smiles too much. He says he has a gift for you, no strings attached.

opciones.detalle: 60%: a rare item. 40%: he robs you.

azar.resultado: It's real. You still don't trust him.
By the time you notice, your pouch is lighter. He is gone.

opciones.resultado: He stops smiling.
He shrugs. He seems genuinely disappointed.

eventos.texto: A lady receives you in a red hall. She has a job, and she pays well.

opciones.resultado: She gives you a name and a place. Better not to ask more.

opciones.detalle: Gain a rare blessing. Curse: Foreign Blood.
opciones.resultado: The wine tastes of iron.
She says the door will stay open.

eventos.texto: A tree covered in red flowers. The air smells of rot and honey.

opciones.detalle: Gain a rare blessing. Curse: Rot.
opciones.resultado: It's beautiful. Your skin itches.
It burns slowly. Runes remain among the ashes.
You don't look back.

eventos.texto: From here you can see the whole Erdtree. Its light weighs on your shoulders.

opciones.resultado: Your eyes burn. It's worth it.

azar.resultado: Something falls at your feet.
The Tree does not answer.

opciones.resultado: You'll see it up close soon enough.

eventos.texto: Shelves up to the ceiling. On the lectern, an open tome nobody should read.

opciones.detalle: Gain an uncommon blessing. Enemies get a silver mutator.
opciones.resultado: The letters stay inside your eyes.
It weighs more than it looks.
Some things are better left unknown.

eventos.texto: A giant sleeps on the snow. A huge pouch hangs from his belt.

azar.resultado: He doesn't stir. The pouch is full.
He opens an eye the size of a shield.

opciones.detalle: Elite fight. A rare blessing if you win.
opciones.resultado: He rises slowly. Snow falls from his shoulders.
His snoring follows you for a good while.

eventos.texto: A boat with a lit torch waits by the shore. There is no boatman.

opciones.detalle: Lose 200 runes. Gain a rare item.
opciones.resultado: The boat moves on its own. Something waits on the other side.
The fire doesn't burn the hand that holds it.

azar.resultado: He arrives, takes his fee and leaves without you. He leaves you something.
He never comes.

opciones.resultado: The boat drifts off without you.

eventos.texto: A figure of light floats among the trees. It points at you with a finger that isn't there.

opciones.resultado: It leads you to a clearing and vanishes.

opciones.detalle: Gain a mythic blessing. Curse: Under the Moon.
opciones.resultado: The cold goes straight to the bone.
The light fades behind you.

eventos.texto: On the hilltop, a huge warrior rests his axe on the ground. He is watching you.

opciones.detalle: Elite fight. An uncommon blessing if you win.
opciones.resultado: He raises the axe. The sky darkens.
He takes them without a word.
When you look again, he is gone.

eventos.texto: The main gate is shut. A guard leans over the wall and asks for a toll.

opciones.detalle: Lose 150 runes. Gain an uncommon item.
opciones.resultado: The gate opens just enough to let you through.

opciones.detalle: 70%: a common blessing. 30%: you are spotted.

azar.resultado: A broken grate by the moat.
Someone shouts from the wall.

opciones.resultado: The castle will still be there.

eventos.texto: Golden roots break through the ground. They throb as if they had a pulse.

opciones.detalle: A rare blessing. Curse: Foreign Blood.
opciones.resultado: It tastes of gold and earth.
It writhes in your hand for a moment.
You dream of a tree that never ends.
The roots keep growing.

eventos.texto: Two skeletons haul a cart with a golden statue. They cross your path.

opciones.resultado: The skeletons drop the ropes and turn around.

opciones.detalle: A random item. Enemies get a silver mutator.
opciones.resultado: Nobody stops you. That's the scary part.
The wheels creak until they fade away.

eventos.texto: A statue sits on a throne, waist-deep in water. It holds a chalice.

opciones.detalle: Gain an uncommon blessing. Enemies get a gold mutator.
opciones.resultado: The water in the chalice isn't wet.

azar.resultado: Something shines at the bottom.
Only stones and cold.

opciones.resultado: For a moment, you feel like a king.
The throne stays empty.

eventos.texto: An old dragon sleeps in the water. One of its scales is loose, as big as a door.

opciones.resultado: The whole swamp rises.
Others weren't so lucky.
It doesn't notice a thing.

eventos.texto: A portrait covered in candles. The woman in it has the eyes of someone you know.

opciones.resultado: A candle goes out on its own.
Behind it, a hollow with coins. And a name written down.
The eyes follow you to the door.

eventos.texto: A golden sign floats above the grass. Someone left it for you. Or against you.

azar.resultado: The light wraps around you and stays.
An invader steps out of the light.

opciones.resultado: A spirit greets you and leaves.
It goes out like an ember.

eventos.texto: Two figures dine in silence. There is a third plate. They are waiting for you.

opciones.detalle: Gain an uncommon blessing. Enemies get a silver mutator.
opciones.resultado: The food tastes of nothing. But you feel different.
Real silver.
Nobody stops you. Nobody says goodbye.

eventos.texto: A huge aqueduct crosses the valley. Up top, something shines at the edge of the drop.

opciones.detalle: 60%: a rare item. 40%: you fall and lose 150 runes.

azar.resultado: You make it. It was worth it.
You slip. The runes fall with you.

opciones.resultado: It takes a while. But it falls.
It carries coins others lost.
You lose an hour. Nothing else.
